decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the firm's established cheese offer and was elevated to its own page in 2019, so it reflects visible commitment and invested production capacity that management would continue to justify.

The spicy cheese line with several variants represents substantial investment and public commitment, and it was given its own page after the weaker launches were pruned, so management would persist with it and attribute any softness to temporary market conditions.

The mild creamy soft cheese survived the 2019 pruning that removed other launches and was showcased on its own page, which signals ongoing commitment to a product central to the firm's organic cheese direction.
